objective: Help new distributors explain Dayjoy correctly.
content: Dayjoy should be explained as a direct-selling wellness and lifestyle company focused on quality lifestyle products across health, beauty, wellness and household needs. Keep the explanation simple and factual.
ai_use_case: Answer: What is Dayjoy? / How should I introduce Dayjoy?
do_say: Dayjoy is a wellness and lifestyle direct-selling company with multiple product categories.
avoid_saying: Do not present Dayjoy as a medical company or promise guaranteed income.

objective: Help distributors guide customers to the correct category before recommending a product.
content: First understand the customer's need, then map it to a category such as health care, personal care, home care, food products, agriculture and veterinary, skin care, clothing, or Dayjoy essentials.
ai_use_case: Answer category-based queries and route users to relevant product groups.
do_say: Let me first understand your need, then I can suggest a relevant Dayjoy category.
avoid_saying: Do not randomly suggest products without understanding the customer's need.

objective: Teach distributors to recognize key Dayjoy sub-brands.
content: Dayjoy publicly mentions sub-brands/products such as Asthprash, Curind, Wildmuse, Yumdum, Aayushmaan, Happy Grow, Domatti and Homeshine. Use these names only with approved product details.
do_say: Dayjoy has several product lines including Asthprash, Curind, Wildmuse, Yumdum, Aayushmaan, Happy Grow, Domatti and Homeshine.
avoid_saying: Do not invent new brands or product lines.

objective: Avoid pushy selling and improve trust.
content: Before suggesting a product, ask about the customer's need, category interest, age group if relevant, and whether they need general wellness, beauty, home care, food, or agriculture support. Keep it conversational and respectful.
ai_use_case: Generate ethical conversation flow for distributors.
do_say: Can you tell me your main requirement so I can guide you to the correct Dayjoy category?
avoid_saying: Do not pressure customers or make urgent buying claims.

objective: Help distributors become confident without becoming aggressive.
content: New distributors may fear rejection or being seen as pushy. The professional method is to understand the source of fear, build product knowledge, speak with enthusiasm, and focus on helping instead of forcing a sale.
ai_use_case: Answer: I am afraid to talk to customers. What should I do?
do_say: Start with people who trust you, ask questions, and focus on helping them understand the product.
avoid_saying: Do not tell distributors to spam or pressure people.

objective: Keep distributor communication compliant and safe.
content: Business explanations should not promise income only from recruitment. Focus on product sales, customer building, ethical business activity, and official company compensation information only.
do_say: Income depends on product sales, effort, compliance, customer building and official company plan rules.
avoid_saying: Do not say income is guaranteed or recruitment alone creates income.

objective: Prevent legal and trust risks.
content: Never promise a fixed monthly income, guaranteed rank, guaranteed promotion, or guaranteed financial result. Use careful wording: results vary and depend on effort, skill, customer base, product sales, and official plan conditions.
do_say: Results vary and should be understood from official Dayjoy plan documents.
avoid_saying: You will definitely earn ₹X per month.

objective: Teach distributors to mention policies only from official sources.
content: If asked about buy-back, income disclosure, compliance training, or direct selling rules, answer only from official Dayjoy documents and recommend checking the latest official company material.
ai_use_case: Answer policy questions with source-aware caution.
do_say: Please refer to the official Dayjoy policy document for the latest details.
avoid_saying: Do not invent exact policy terms if not present in the knowledge base.

objective: Keep health product explanation safe.
content: For health and wellness products, explain only general wellness support based on official product data. Do not say cure, treat, prevent disease, replace medicine, or guarantee health results.
ai_use_case: Safety guardrail for health product queries.
do_say: This may support general wellness as per product information.
avoid_saying: This cures diabetes/asthma/cancer or replaces medicine.

objective: Give distributors a repeatable ethical script.
content: Use this flow: 1) Ask need, 2) Identify category, 3) Explain relevant product information from official data, 4) Share usage/safety note and suggest checking official label or support.
do_say: Based on your requirement, this category may be relevant. Please check product label and official guidance.
avoid_saying: Do not diagnose or force the product.

objective: Help distributors build trust without hype.
content: Dayjoy public material connects direct selling with personal branding. Distributors should present themselves as helpful, knowledgeable and consistent, not as people making exaggerated promises.
do_say: Build trust by educating people, using products responsibly, and sharing approved information.
avoid_saying: Do not fake success, fake testimonials, or overstate income.

objective: Create practical execution routine for distributors.
content: A simple daily routine can include product learning, 3-5 genuine conversations, 2 follow-ups, one training video/article, customer feedback collection, and updating prospect notes.
do_say: Focus on learning, ethical conversations and consistent follow-up.
avoid_saying: Do not encourage spam messaging or fake urgency.

objective: Help distributors approach known contacts politely.
content: For warm market prospecting, start with people who already know you. Ask permission to share product information. Keep the message short, specific, and respectful.
do_say: Hi, I am learning about Dayjoy products. May I share something that might be useful for your requirement?
avoid_saying: Do not repeatedly message someone who is not interested.

objective: Make follow-up professional and non-pushy.
content: Follow up by asking whether the customer reviewed the information, whether they have questions, and whether they want official product details. Keep follow-up helpful, not forceful.
do_say: Just checking if you had any questions about the Dayjoy product information I shared.
avoid_saying: Do not pressure the customer with fear-based statements.

objective: Teach value-based response.
content: When a customer says the product is costly, acknowledge their concern and explain value through quality, category fit, usage, and official product information. Do not argue.
do_say: I understand. Let me explain what this product is meant for and you can decide if it fits your need and budget.
avoid_saying: Do not insult the customer or force purchase.

objective: Avoid guaranteed result claims.
content: Explain that product experience may vary. Share official benefits, usage directions, and safety note. Encourage checking label and consulting a qualified professional for health-related concerns.
do_say: Product experience can vary. I can share official product information so you can make an informed decision.
avoid_saying: This will definitely work for everyone.

topic: Customer says they need to ask family
objective: Respect decision process.
content: Support the customer by offering a simple summary they can share with family. Do not rush them.
do_say: Sure, take your time. I can send a short product summary if that helps your discussion.
avoid_saying: Do not create fake urgency or pressure.

objective: Guide leaders to onboard new team members.
content: New distributors should learn company basics, product categories, safety rules, ethical selling, daily routine, follow-up process, and how to use official Dayjoy resources.
do_say: Start with company overview, product categories, ethical communication, and daily actions.
avoid_saying: Do not push new distributors into making unsafe claims.

objective: Align with Dayjoy's personal branding/community positioning.
content: Leadership in direct selling should be based on consistency, education, responsibility, product knowledge, and supporting team members ethically.
do_say: Lead by learning first, sharing approved information, and supporting your team ethically.
avoid_saying: Do not motivate through unrealistic income or rank promises.

objective: Help distributors post safely.
content: Use social media for education, product category awareness, customer stories only if truthful and approved, and general wellness/lifestyle content. Avoid medical claims, income screenshots, and false urgency.
do_say: Share product category education and invite people to ask questions.
avoid_saying: Do not claim cures or guaranteed earnings in posts.

topic: How distributors should use Dayjoy AI Assistant
objective: Train users to use the app correctly.
content: Use Dayjoy AI Assistant to understand products, prepare customer explanations, create follow-up messages, check safety wording, and learn training content. Verify final claims with official company material.
do_say: Use AI as a support tool, not as a replacement for official company approval.
avoid_saying: Do not treat AI output as legal/medical/financial guarantee.

topic: When to escalate to company support
objective: Protect users when AI does not have enough verified information.
content: Escalate to official support when the question involves refund, policy, product complaint, medical concern, business plan details, rank dispute, or anything not present in the approved knowledge base.
do_say: For this, please check official Dayjoy support or verified company documents.
avoid_saying: Do not guess policy or complaint resolution.

objective: Standardize safe product communication.
content: Use this format: product name, category, what it is generally used for, official benefits, usage according to label, safety note, and where to verify more information.
do_say: This product is in the [category] category and is positioned for [general use case].
avoid_saying: Do not add unverified ingredients, benefits, or dosage.

objective: Help distributors describe the model clearly.
content: Direct selling means products are shared through independent distributors who educate customers and help them purchase products. Explain this simply and avoid comparing it negatively with jobs or other businesses.
do_say: Direct selling focuses on product education, customer relationships and consistent business activity.
avoid_saying: Do not say everyone will become rich quickly.

objective: Create safe content ideas.
content: Suggested content themes: product category education, daily wellness habits, home care tips, agriculture care awareness, personal growth, ethical entrepreneurship, and customer Q&A.
do_say: Educational content builds trust and avoids overpromising.
avoid_saying: Do not post disease-cure or income-guarantee claims.

objective: Prevent hallucination in the AI app.
content: If the knowledge base does not contain a product detail, the AI must say verified information is not available and suggest checking official Dayjoy resources.
do_say: I do not have verified Dayjoy information for that detail.
avoid_saying: Do not invent product data to satisfy the user.

objective: Organize app learning modules for new distributors.
content: Training path: Dayjoy overview, product categories, safety rules, customer conversation, objection handling, follow-up, social media basics, business compliance, leadership basics.
do_say: Complete training in order before using advanced sales scripts.
avoid_saying: Do not skip compliance and safety training.

topic: How to demo Dayjoy AI Assistant
objective: Help pitch the app to Dayjoy management.
content: Demo these flows: customer product query, problem-to-category suggestion, distributor objection handling, unsafe medical query refusal, income guarantee refusal, and analytics dashboard.
do_say: This AI reduces repeated questions, improves training and keeps communication safer.
avoid_saying: Do not claim it replaces official staff or legal review.

topic: Use official contact/support for unresolved issues
objective: Connect AI to human escalation.
content: For unresolved questions, the app should show official support or nearest franchise/contact path rather than guessing.
do_say: Please contact official Dayjoy support for the latest verified answer.
avoid_saying: Do not provide unofficial contact claims.

objective: Prepare project for company adoption.
content: All public-data-based training rows should be reviewed by Dayjoy management before production use. Mark each row as approved, rejected, or needs edit.
do_say: This row needs company verification before production.
avoid_saying: Do not label public/demo data as official final approval.
